LanguageData.BOR_CMC1005H.description: A tenebral Helmet with integrated X-ray vision, tool assist and medical analysis systems onboard.
LanguageData.BOR_CMC1005a.label: CMC-1005 Light Powered Medical Suit
LanguageData.BOR_CMC1005a.description: A lighter and more agile version of the CMC-900, the CMC-1005, often called as "Tenebral Valkyries" affectionately by troopers in the Koprulu sector, is a utility version of the armor designed to keep key medical staff safe even in the direct frontlines while they assist injured troops. As such, the armor itself is weaker than their combat counterpart but have several integrated toolkits and systems designed to help medical procedures. However, the armor itself only contributes towards mending of wounds and stabilization of serious injuries, the clumbersomeness of it actually detracts from precision surgeries.

LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorCataphract.label: quasar cataphract armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorCataphract.descr: A suit of heavy powered quasar armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered quasar alloy-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPhoeni: A variant of quasar cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nPhoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, as in underground or shipborne operations. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPresti: A suit of heavy powered quasar armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered quasar alloy-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetCataphract: A heavily-armored quasar-tech helmet, with a solid quasar alloy-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.

A heavily-armored quasar-tech helmet, with a solid quasar alloy-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetReconPrest: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective quasar alloy-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorLocust.label: quasar locust armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorLocust.descripti: A variant of quasar recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.\n\nUnlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. They usually avoid static shootouts, preferring to jump straight into enemy fortifications and fight hand-to-hand. They do poorly in static defense or confined quarters, but excel in mixed cover or shipcracking operations.
A variant of quasar marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nGrenadiers usually specialize in breaching buildings or internal ship bulkheads. While not effective at very long range, grenadiers can be surprisingly deadly in confined quarters.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorMarineHelmetPres: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered quasar alloy-weave plates.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorMarinePrestige.d: A suit of powered armor. Layered quasar alloy-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ArmorReconPrestige.de: A suit of light partially-powered quasar armor, designed to permit quick movement. Quasar Alloy-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_AssaultArmor.label: kwazaari assault armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_AssaultArmor.descript: An Ultra-heavy kwazaari protective armor, "Bjorn III" cladded with layers of composite quasar alloy-weave and reactive armor plates. The wearer of this armor is practically become a walking tank. This armor achieved tremendous protection at the expense of moving speed. It has an integrated short-range EMP grenade launcher.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.label: kwazaari assault helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.descrip: Rugged and trustworthy kwazaari helmet of the kwazaari assault armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_CloseCombatArmor.desc: Quasar power armor with a built-in shield, "Excelsior III" is a close combat focused power armor with maneuverability, durability, and lethality.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_CloseCombatHelmet.des: Quasar elmet of a "Excelsior III" close combat armor. It assist wearer with neural close combat enhancement system.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Dropsuit.label: kwazaari drop suit
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Dropsuit.description: Yeonhwa Precision Quasar Drop Suit model 412f, 'JanYeong(shadow remains) III'. Built for the YeonHwa Aggresive Marketing Division's drop troops, this completely enclosed suit is designed to perform low orbit jump action. Its integrated long-ranged jump pack makes JanYeong ideal equipment for the rapid insertion mission.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_DropsuitH.label: kwazaari dropsuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_DropsuitH.description: It is a state-of-the-art kwazaari helmet, optimized for EVA and orbital drop operations. This helmet has lots of shiny gadgets. Of course, all of these flashing toys are useless in the surface environment except the targeting assist pseudo A.I.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Exoframe.label: kwazaari exo-frame
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Exoframe.description: A kwazaari exoframe is a mobile machine that is powered by a system of motors, pneumatics, levers or hydraulics that allow for limb movement and assists the wearer by boosting their strength and endurance.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FSArmor.label: kwazaari fire support armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FSArmor.description: If you need a walking turret, call the "Varg III" kwazaari fire support armor. Rapid reloading system, additional ammo container, built in fire control system, everything of the "Varg III" focused on fire support. In return, the Varg is very vulnerable to close combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FSArmorH.label: kwazaari fire support helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_FSArmorH.description: Quasar helmet of the kwazaari "Varg III" fire support armor. Share the features with the fire support armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Gunlink.label: gunlink
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Gunlink.description: A quasar targeting computer that helps the user aim. It detects and analyzes targets using infrared, visible, and millimeter-wave electromagnetic sensors. An onboard targeting computer displays firing solutions on a retinal projection. It offers no protection at all.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_HazardCarapace.label: kwazaari hazard carapace
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_HazardCarapace.descri: The "Alecto III" kwazaari hazard carapace is designed to carry out mission even in the worst environment. In extreme cold area, in a heat wave, and even in radioactive wasteland, Tisiphone hunters can continue their endless hunting.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_HazardCarapaceH.label: kwazaari hazard helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_HazardCarapaceH.descr: A kwazaari helmet of an "Alecto III" hazard carapace. This helmet provides excellent environmental protection.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_HeavyMarineArmor.desc: A suit of heavy powered kwazaari armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered quasar alloy-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Judicator.label: riot gear
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Judicator.description: A "Judicator" kwazaari riot gear was produced by Arms Dynamics for Federation human commanders. This is a really great personal armor if you can withstand from scornful eyes of the people.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_JudicatorH.label: kwazaari riot gear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_JudicatorH.descriptio: It is a kwazaari helmet of the FPC riot gear. If you wear this, you will be an eyesore of your colony.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Korp.label: kwazaari artillery armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Korp.description: A kwazaari variant of the "Varg III" kwazaari fire support armor, the "Korp(Raven) III" artillery armor originated from modified makeshift equipment of frontlines. All unnecessary equipment was removed from Korp to mount a huge mortar, "Crow feeder." The purpose of this equipment is simple; turn the wearer into walking artillery. The only ammunition this mortar can shoot is high-explosive shells.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MarksmanGear.label: kwazaari marksman gear
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MarksmanGear.descript: Arms Dynamics "Condemner" kwazaari Marksman gear. With joint stabilizer unit, this outfit assure steady aim. Standard issue gear of the Federation Peacebringer assassin corps.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.label: marksmangear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.descrip: It is a kwazaari helmet of the "Condemner" marksman gear. Integrated target designator guarantees high accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MedicArmor.label: kwazaari modular Medic armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MedicArmor.descriptio: Designed for combat medics, the "Hospitaller III" kwazaari armor is the medical variant of the "Warrior III" kwazaari modular body protection system. The armor is equipped with a variety of medical tools and supplies, so the wearer can treat the injured in the field.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MedicH.label: kwazaari medic helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_MedicH.description: A kwazaari helmet of the "Hospitaller III" kwazaari Medic armor. The built-in AI medical interface assists the wearer during medical procedures.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_NomadArmor.label: kwazaari modular nomad armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_NomadArmor.descriptio: "Akicita III", the long-range kwazaari scout variant of the kwazaari "Warrior III" modular body protection system. This outfit recycles the wearer's body waste and moisture, provides heat and cold protection and sound dampening, and assists the wearer with servo motors and a lightweight exoskeleton. The wearer needs less sleep, moves faster, hunting quieter. Originally designed as a protective device for explorers, guerrillas and caravans of rimworlds soon realized the amazing potential of the equipment.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_NomadH.label: kwazaari nomad helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_NomadH.description: A kwazaari helmet of the "Akicita III" kwazaari nomad armor. Its long-range observation equipment can also be used for aiming.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PioneerArmor.label: kwazaari modular pioneer armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PioneerArmor.descript: A kwazaari armor designed primarily for combat engineer, Greydale "Laconian III" pioneer armor has integrated tool set. It's a pretty good gear for builds something while gunfight.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PioneerH.label: kwazaari pioneer helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PioneerH.description: A helmet of the "Laconian III" pioneer armor. A simple pain damper system integrated.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ProtectiveGear.label: kwazaari heavy flak armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ProtectiveGear.descri: A heavy, non-power assisted kwazaari protective gear. While it doesn't have defensive strength of power armor, this armor covers your whole body.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ProtectiveHelmet.desc: A heavy kwazaari combat helmet. Protects whole head.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ReflactorArmor.label: kwazaari reflactor carapace
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ReflactorArmor.descri: The "Nemesis III" is a powered armor that created to hunt the Federation remnants. Almost immune to the heat energy, the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent provides this armor to their elite hunters.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ReflactorArmorH.label: kwazaari reflactor helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_ReflactorArmorH.descr: A kwazaari helmet with a complete set of heat deflector system.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_RoyalSiegeArmor.label: prestige Quasar siegebreaker armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_RoyalSiegeArmor.descr: A suit of heavy powered Quasar armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered Quasar alloy-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_RoyalTrooperArmor.des: A suit of light minimally-powered Quasar armor. Lightweight Quasar alloy-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_SecurityArmor.label: kwazaari modular security armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_SecurityArmor.descrip: The kwazaari configuration of the Greydale modular body protection system, the "Warrior III" security armor provides modest protection for most body parts. If you have the proper equipment, It can be reassembled into other armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_SecurityHelmet.label: kwazaari security helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_SecurityHelmet.descri: A kwazaari helmet of the "Warrior III" kwazaari security armor. A simple and robust protection gear.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Strikesuit.label: kwazaari strike suit
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_Strikesuit.descriptio: Yeonhwa Precision Strike Suit model 383a, 'ChangWol(Azure Moon) III'. Designed for urban strike teams, this sophisticated suit have short-ranged, fast jump thrusters for rapid assault. In order to maximize the operational capacity of this suit, the wearer requires fast reaction speed and exceptional boldness.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_StrikesuitH.label: kwazaari strikesuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_StrikesuitH.descripti: A kwazaari helmet of the delicate kwazaari strike suit. Sophisticated nerve assist system inside this helmet makes the wearer act faster.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacArmor.label: kwazaari tactical armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacArmor.description: An ergonomically designed kwazaari body armor. This type of armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacHelmet.label: kwazaari tactical helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacHelmet.description: Advanced kwazaari combat helmet designed specifically to protect the head during combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacVest.label: kwazaari tactical vest
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TacVest.description: An ergonomically designed kwazaari body armor. This type of kwazaari armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TrooperArmor.label: kwazaari trooper armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_TrooperArmor.descript: A suit of light minimally-powered armor. Lightweight quasar alloy-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGCloak.label: unity guard kwazaari cloak
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGCloak.description: Quasar cloak that usually worn by the federation unity guards. It's more like to ornament than practical outfit.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGCuirass.label: unity guard kwazaari cuirass
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGCuirass.description: Standard issue kwazaari body armor of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGHelmet.label: unity guard kwazaari helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_UGHelmet.description: Standard issue kwazaari helmet of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Bullet_Crowfeeder.label: crow feeder kwazaari shell
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Bullet_MiniShotgun.label: quasar shotgun blast
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Bullet_NeedleGun.label: quasar needle shot
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Bullet_Spiner.label: quasar spine
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Bullet_ToxicNeedleGun.label: quasar toxic needle
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Carbonsuit.label: kwazaari bodysuit
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Carbonsuit.description: A full kwazaari bodysuit made of quasar alloy crystalline fiber. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_FedSuit.label: kwazaari federation jumpsuit
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_FedSuit.description: A carbon crystalline fiber kwazaari jumpsuit for military personnel. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy. It is the uniform of the Federation.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_BeamGraser.label: quasar beam graser
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_BeamGraser.description: A high-energy gamma ray laser which fires a sweeping beam that pierces thick armor and burns targets. Because of the health risks, grasers are usually only used by mechanoids. This one was made to interface directly with a mechanoid wielder and draw from its power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.label: quasar mini-flameblaster
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.descript: A small burst-oriented flamethrower used by mechanoids.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_MiniShotgun.label: quasar mini-shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_MiniShotgun.description: A compact, short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_NeedleLauncher.label: quasar needle launcher
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_NeedleLauncher.descriptio: This mechanoid weapon is a compact version of the needle gun. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. The needle launcher has less range than its counterpart but is lightweight, allowing it to be wielded by fast-moving mechs.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_Spiner.label: quasar spiner
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_Spiner.description: A very small gun used by war urchins which quickly fires spine-like projectiles. It is short-ranged but deadly.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_ToxicNeedle.label: quasar toxic needle gun
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Gun_ToxicNeedle.description: A mechanoid-built gun that fires toxin-infused metal needles. It can fire long distances and will poison the target in addition to doing physical damage.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Headgear_HeavyMarineHelmet.de: A heavily-armored quasar-tech helmet, with a solid quasar alloy-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Headgear_RoyalSiegeHelmet.des: A heavily-armored Quasar-tech helmet, with a solid Quasar alloy-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Headgear_RoyalTrooperHelmet.d: A Quasar-tech and lightweight armored helmet with a protective Quasar alloy-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Headgear_TrooperHelmet.label: kwazaari trooper helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Headgear_TrooperHelmet.descri: A high-tech and lightweight armored kwazaari helmet with a protective quasar alloy-weave plate.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Agrihand.label: quasar agrihand
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Agrihand.description: A small quasar mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops. While it is better suited to labor than combat, it can fight with built-in cutting blades if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Apocriton.label: quasar apocriton
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Apocriton.description: A quasar mechanoid commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. Its most obvious power is its ability to resurrect recently-killed mechs by supercharging their self-repair processes. Less obviously, it is intelligent and psychically present, radiating hatred into the minds of anyone in a wide radius. It can also move quickly with its built-in jump launcher.\n\nWhile all mechanoids have a dim psychically-present intelligence, only the apocriton and a few others truly feel hatred for their victims and understand the suffering they inflict.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Cleansweeper.label: quasar cleansweeper
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Cleansweeper.description: A light quasar mechanoid designed for cleaning. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Constructoid.label: quasar constructoid
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Constructoid.description: A small quasar mechanoid designed to perform construction tasks. It can perform blunt melee attacks if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Fabricor.label: quasar fabricor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Fabricor.description: A small quasar work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Legionary.label: quasar legionary
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Legionary.description: A quasar combat support mechanoid with a wide-range bullet shield and mid-range needle gun. Designed to support other mechanoids, the legionary is vulnerable to anyone who can get inside its shield.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Lifter.label: quasar lifter
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Lifter.description: A small quasar mechanoid designed for hauling. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Militor.label: quasar militor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Militor.description: A small combat quasar mechanoid armed with a low-power mini-shotgun. Roughly four feet tall, militors lack the power, range, and toughness of more senior combat mechs. However, it is cheap to gestate and maintain, and so is often used as a rear guard or swarm attacker.\n\nIn war, mech armies are known to send militors into urban ruins to hunt down survivors after breaking the human defenses. For this reason, they are considered by some to be the most cruel of all mechanoid patterns.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Paramedic.label: quasar paramedic
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Paramedic.description: A small quasar mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Scorcher.label: quasar scorcher
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Scorcher.description: A close-approach quasar war mechanoid that specializes in incendiary attacks. Its flame burst attack has little reach, but once it closes on a group of defenders it can ignite and disrupt them with blasts of searing flame.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Tesseron.label: quasar tesseron
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Tesseron.description: A quasar medium-range combat mechanoid. While it is fairly vulnerable to attacks, the tesseron's sweeping beam graser can pierce thick armor and even ignite shielded targets.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Tunneler.label: quasar tunneler
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_Tunneler.description: A heavy quasar mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_WarUrchin.label: quasar war urchin
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Mech_WarUrchin.description: A small, deployable quasar combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war queen mech. War urchins are expendable fighters designed to swarm-attack enemies. They are mounted with short-ranged spiner guns and have a non-rechargeable power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_PPSH.label: Quasar Power Suit Helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_PPSH.description: An older prototype version of the CMC series of power armor, the PPS was designed to give solid bulky protection and a rudimentary life support sistem in dangerous or low O2 battle situation.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_PPSa.label: Quasar Power Suit
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_PPSa.description: A powerful power armor stylized to resemble the old Pressurized Power Suits, made with quasar alloys.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Proj_BjornGrenadeEMP.label: EMP grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Proj_GrenadePhoenixFire.label: quasar incendiary grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Proj_GrenadierGrenade.label: quasar frag grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorBase.label: kwazaari guardian armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorBase.descript: A suit of specialty kwazaari power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorBase_Prestige: A suit of specialty kwazaari power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields. \n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet.label: kwazaari guardian helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet.descri: A modified kwazaari marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard kwazaari marine helmet.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet_Presti: A modified kwazaari marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard kwazaari marine helmet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmor.label: phalanx armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmor.description: A suit of heavy powered armor based on the standard Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer. \nMechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.label: kwazaari phalanx helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.descrip: A heavy kwazaari Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard kwazaari Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet_Prestig: A heavy kwazaari Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard kwazaari Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_PhalanxArmor_Prestige.desc:
A suit of heavy kwazaari powered armor based on the standard kwazaari Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Mechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmor.label: kwazaari ranseur armor
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmor.description: A highly specialized suit of light kwazaari power-armor. Quasar anseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time. \nRanseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.label: kwazaari ranseur helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.descrip: A high-tech armored helmet designed for use with a set of kwazaari ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet_Prestig: A high-tech armored kwazaari helmet designed for use with a set of kwazaari ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_RanseurArmor_Prestige.desc:
A highly specialized suit of light kwazaari power-armor. Quasar ranseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Ranseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_StealthBelt.label: personal kwazaari cloaking system
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_RA_StealthBelt.description: An kwazaari cloaking system worn on the belt. It is less efficient than a suit of kwazaari ranseur armor, and it can only hold enough nuclear fuel for one charge at a time.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_SleepAccelerator.label: quasarite sleep accelerator
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_SleepAccelerator.description: A quasarite bedside device that accelerates the sleeper's circadian rhythm. This speeds up sleep, but consumes a lot of electricity and also causes increased hunger. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one sleep accelerator near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_VAE_Footwear_MarineBoots.desc: A pair of kwazaari marine boots with layered quasar alloy plates and enhanced servomotors.
LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_VAE_Handwear_MarineGloves.des: A pair of kwazaari marine gloves with enhanced grip assistance and set of embedded quasar alloy recoil stabilisers.
LanguageData.BOR_ReverseMoisturePump_I.label: solar reverse moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_ReverseMoisturePump_I.description: Very slowly unbalances moisture in nearby terrain, converting dry ground into shallow water. Does not affect sand.
LanguageData.BOR_ReverseMoisturePump_II.label: quasar reverse moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_ReverseMoisturePump_II.description: Very slowly unbalances moisture in nearby terrain, converting dry ground into shallow water. Does not affect sand.

LanguageData.BOR_ReverseMoisturePump_III.description: Very slowly unbalances moisture in nearby terrain, converting dry ground into shallow water. Does not affect sand.

LanguageData.BOR_ShallowerPump_I.description: Very slowly raises lake-beds and sea-beds, converting deep water into shallow water. Has a smaller area of effect than other pumps due to the limitations of this process.
