LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorCataphract.label: solar cataphract armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorCataphract.descri: A suit of heavy powered solar armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered starsteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPhoenix: A variant of solar cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nPhoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, as in underground or shipborne operations. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPrestig: A suit of heavy powered solar armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered starsteel-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
A heavily-armored solar-tech helmet, with a solid starsteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetCataphractP: A heavily-armored solar-tech helmet, with a solid starsteel-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorHelmetReconPresti: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective starsteel-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorLocust.label: solar locust armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorLocust.descriptio: A variant of solar recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.\n\nUnlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. They usually avoid static shootouts, preferring to jump straight into enemy fortifications and fight hand-to-hand. They do poorly in static defense or confined quarters, but excel in mixed cover or shipcracking operations.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorMarineGrenadier.d: A variant of solar marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nGrenadiers usually specialize in breaching buildings or internal ship bulkheads. While not effective at very long range, grenadiers can be surprisingly deadly in confined quarters.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorMarineHelmetPrest: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered starsteel-weave plates.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorMarinePrestige.de: A suit of powered armor. Layered starsteel-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ArmorReconPrestige.des: A suit of light partially-powered solar armor, designed to permit quick movement. Starsteel-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_AssaultArmor.label: solar assault armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_AssaultArmor.descripti: An Ultra-heavy solar protective armor, "Bjorn II" cladded with layers of composite sunsteel-weave and reactive armor plates. The wearer of this armor is practically become a walking tank. This armor achieved tremendous protection at the expense of moving speed. It has an integrated short-range EMP grenade launcher.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.label: solar assault helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.descript: Rugged and trustworthy solar helmet of the solar assault armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_CloseCombatArmor.label: solar close combat armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_CloseCombatArmor.descr: Solar power armor with a built-in shield, "Excelsior II" is a close combat focused power armor with maneuverability, durability, and lethality.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_CloseCombatHelmet.desc: Solar elmet of a "Excelsior II" close combat armor. It assist wearer with neural close combat enhancement system.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Dropsuit.label: solar drop suit
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Dropsuit.description: Yeonhwa Precision Solar Drop Suit model 412f, 'JanYeong(shadow remains) II'. Built for the YeonHwa Aggresive Marketing Division's drop troops, this completely enclosed suit is designed to perform low orbit jump action. Its integrated long-ranged jump pack makes JanYeong ideal equipment for the rapid insertion mission.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_DropsuitH.label: solar dropsuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_DropsuitH.description: It is a state-of-the-art solar helmet, optimized for EVA and orbital drop operations. This helmet has lots of shiny gadgets. Of course, all of these flashing toys are useless in the surface environment except the targeting assist pseudo A.I.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Exoframe.label: solar exo-frame
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Exoframe.description: A solar exoframe is a mobile machine that is powered by a system of motors, pneumatics, levers or hydraulics that allow for limb movement and assists the wearer by boosting their strength and endurance.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FSArmor.label: solar fire support armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FSArmor.description: If you need a walking turret, call the "Varg II" solar fire support armor. Rapid reloading system, additional ammo container, built in fire control system, everything of the "Varg II" focused on fire support. In return, the Varg is very vulnerable to close combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FSArmorH.label: solar fire support helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_FSArmorH.description: Solar helmet of the solar "Varg II" fire support armor. Share the features with the fire support armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Gunlink.label: gunlink
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Gunlink.description: A solar targeting computer that helps the user aim. It detects and analyzes targets using infrared, visible, and millimeter-wave electromagnetic sensors. An onboard targeting computer displays firing solutions on a retinal projection. It offers no protection at all.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HazardCarapace.label: solar hazard carapace
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HazardCarapace.descrip: The "Alecto II" solar hazard carapace is designed to carry out mission even in the worst environment. In extreme cold area, in a heat wave, and even in radioactive wasteland, Tisiphone hunters can continue their endless hunting.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HazardCarapaceH.label: solar hazard helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HazardCarapaceH.descri: A solar helmet of an "Alecto II" hazard carapace. This helmet provides excellent environmental protection.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HeavyMarineArmor.label: solar siegebreaker armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_HeavyMarineArmor.descr: A suit of heavy powered solar armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered sunsteel-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Judicator.label: riot gear
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Judicator.description: A "Judicator" solar riot gear was produced by Arms Dynamics for Federation human commanders. This is a really great personal armor if you can withstand from scornful eyes of the people.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_JudicatorH.label: solar riot gear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_JudicatorH.description: It is a solar helmet of the FPC riot gear. If you wear this, you will be an eyesore of your colony.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Korp.label: solar artillery armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Korp.description: A solar variant of the "Varg II" solar fire support armor, the "Korp(Raven) II" artillery armor originated from modified makeshift equipment of frontlines. All unnecessary equipment was removed from Korp to mount a huge mortar, "Crow feeder." The purpose of this equipment is simple; turn the wearer into walking artillery. The only ammunition this mortar can shoot is high-explosive shells.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MarksmanGear.label: solar marksman gear
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MarksmanGear.descripti: Arms Dynamics "Condemner" solar Marksman gear. With joint stabilizer unit, this outfit assure steady aim. Standard issue gear of the Federation Peacebringer assassin corps.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.label: marksmangear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.descript: It is a solar helmet of the "Condemner" marksman gear. Integrated target designator guarantees high accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MedicArmor.label: solar modular Medic armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MedicArmor.description: Designed for combat medics, the "Hospitaller II" solar armor is the medical variant of the "Warrior II" solar modular body protection system. The armor is equipped with a variety of medical tools and supplies, so the wearer can treat the injured in the field.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MedicH.label: solar medic helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_MedicH.description: A solar helmet of the "Hospitaller II" solar Medic armor. The built-in AI medical interface assists the wearer during medical procedures.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_NomadArmor.label: solar modular nomad armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_NomadArmor.description: "Akicita II", the long-range solar scout variant of the solar "Warrior II" modular body protection system. This outfit recycles the wearer's body waste and moisture, provides heat and cold protection and sound dampening, and assists the wearer with servo motors and a lightweight exoskeleton. The wearer needs less sleep, moves faster, hunting quieter. Originally designed as a protective device for explorers, guerrillas and caravans of rimworlds soon realized the amazing potential of the equipment.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_NomadH.label: solar nomad helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_NomadH.description: A solar helmet of the "Akicita II" solar nomad armor. Its long-range observation equipment can also be used for aiming.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PioneerArmor.label: solar modular pioneer armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PioneerArmor.descripti: A solar armor designed primarily for combat engineer, Greydale "Laconian II" pioneer armor has integrated tool set. It's a pretty good gear for builds something while gunfight.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PioneerH.label: solar pioneer helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_PioneerH.description: A helmet of the "Laconian II" pioneer armor. A simple pain damper system integrated.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ProtectiveGear.label: solar heavy flak armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ProtectiveGear.descrip: A heavy, non-power assisted solar protective gear. While it doesn't have defensive strength of power armor, this armor covers your whole body.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ProtectiveHelmet.label: solar heavy flak helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ProtectiveHelmet.descr: A heavy solar combat helmet. Protects whole head.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ReflactorArmor.label: solar reflactor carapace
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ReflactorArmor.descrip: The "Nemesis II" is a powered armor that created to hunt the Federation remnants. Almost immune to the heat energy, the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent provides this armor to their elite hunters.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ReflactorArmorH.label: solar reflactor helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_ReflactorArmorH.descri: A solar helmet with a complete set of heat deflector system.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_RoyalSiegeArmor.label: prestige Solar siegebreaker armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_RoyalSiegeArmor.descri: A suit of heavy powered Solar armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered sunsteel-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_RoyalTrooperArmor.desc: A suit of light minimally-powered Solar armor. Lightweight sunsteel-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_SecurityArmor.label: solar modular security armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_SecurityArmor.descript: The solar configuration of the Greydale modular body protection system, the "Warrior II" security armor provides modest protection for most body parts. If you have the proper equipment, It can be reassembled into other armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_SecurityHelmet.label: solar security helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_SecurityHelmet.descrip: A solar helmet of the "Warrior II" solar security armor. A simple and robust protection gear.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Strikesuit.label: solar strike suit
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_Strikesuit.description: Yeonhwa Precision Strike Suit model 383a, 'ChangWol(Azure Moon) II'. Designed for urban strike teams, this sophisticated suit have short-ranged, fast jump thrusters for rapid assault. In order to maximize the operational capacity of this suit, the wearer requires fast reaction speed and exceptional boldness.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_StrikesuitH.label: solar strikesuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_StrikesuitH.descriptio: A solar helmet of the delicate solar strike suit. Sophisticated nerve assist system inside this helmet makes the wearer act faster.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacArmor.label: solar tactical armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacArmor.description: An ergonomically designed solar body armor. This type of armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacHelmet.label: solar tactical helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacHelmet.description: Advanced solar combat helmet designed specifically to protect the head during combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacVest.label: solar tactical vest
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TacVest.description: An ergonomically designed solar body armor. This type of solar armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TrooperArmor.label: solar trooper armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_TrooperArmor.descripti: A suit of light minimally-powered armor. Lightweight sunsteel-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGCloak.label: unity guard solar cloak
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGCloak.description: Solar cloak that usually worn by the federation unity guards. It's more like to ornament than practical outfit.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGCuirass.label: unity guard solar cuirass
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGCuirass.description: Standard issue solar body armor of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGHelmet.label: unity guard solar helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Apparel_UGHelmet.description: Standard issue solar helmet of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Bullet_Crowfeeder.label: crow feeder solar shell
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Bullet_MiniShotgun.label: solar shotgun blast
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Bullet_NeedleGun.label: tenebral needle shot
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Bullet_Spiner.label: solar spine
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Bullet_ToxicNeedleGun.label: solar toxic needle
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Carbonsuit.label: solar bodysuit
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Carbonsuit.description: A full solar bodysuit made of sunsteel crystalline fiber. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_FedSuit.label: solar federation jumpsuit
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_FedSuit.description: A carbon crystalline fiber solar jumpsuit for military personnel. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy. It is the uniform of the Federation.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_BeamGraser.label: solar beam graser
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_BeamGraser.description: A high-energy gamma ray laser which fires a sweeping beam that pierces thick armor and burns targets. Because of the health risks, grasers are usually only used by mechanoids. This one was made to interface directly with a mechanoid wielder and draw from its power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.label: solar mini-flameblaster
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.descripti: A small burst-oriented flamethrower used by mechanoids.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_MiniShotgun.label: solar mini-shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_MiniShotgun.description: A compact, short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_NeedleLauncher.label: solar needle launcher
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_NeedleLauncher.description: This mechanoid weapon is a compact version of the needle gun. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. The needle launcher has less range than its counterpart but is lightweight, allowing it to be wielded by fast-moving mechs.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_Spiner.label: solar spiner
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_Spiner.description: A very small gun used by war urchins which quickly fires spine-like projectiles. It is short-ranged but deadly.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_ToxicNeedle.label: solar toxic needle gun
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Gun_ToxicNeedle.description: A mechanoid-built gun that fires toxin-infused metal needles. It can fire long distances and will poison the target in addition to doing physical damage.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Headgear_HeavyMarineHelmet.des: A heavily-armored solar-tech helmet, with a solid sunsteel-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Headgear_RoyalSiegeHelmet.desc: A heavily-armored Solar-tech helmet, with a solid sunsteel-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Headgear_RoyalTrooperHelmet.de: A Solar-tech and lightweight armored helmet with a protective sunsteel-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Headgear_TrooperHelmet.label: solar trooper helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Headgear_TrooperHelmet.descrip: A high-tech and lightweight armored solar helmet with a protective sunsteel-weave plate.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Agrihand.label: solar agrihand
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Agrihand.description: A small solar mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops. While it is better suited to labor than combat, it can fight with built-in cutting blades if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Apocriton.label: solar apocriton
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Apocriton.description: A solar mechanoid commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. Its most obvious power is its ability to resurrect recently-killed mechs by supercharging their self-repair processes. Less obviously, it is intelligent and psychically present, radiating hatred into the minds of anyone in a wide radius. It can also move quickly with its built-in jump launcher.\n\nWhile all mechanoids have a dim psychically-present intelligence, only the apocriton and a few others truly feel hatred for their victims and understand the suffering they inflict.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Cleansweeper.label: solar cleansweeper
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Cleansweeper.description: A light solar mechanoid designed for cleaning. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Constructoid.label: solar constructoid
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Constructoid.description: A small solar mechanoid designed to perform construction tasks. It can perform blunt melee attacks if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Fabricor.label: solar fabricor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Fabricor.description: A small solar work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Legionary.label: solar legionary
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Legionary.description: A solar combat support mechanoid with a wide-range bullet shield and mid-range needle gun. Designed to support other mechanoids, the legionary is vulnerable to anyone who can get inside its shield.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Lifter.label: solar lifter
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Lifter.description: A small solar mechanoid designed for hauling. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Militor.label: solar militor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Militor.description: A small combat solar mechanoid armed with a low-power mini-shotgun. Roughly four feet tall, militors lack the power, range, and toughness of more senior combat mechs. However, it is cheap to gestate and maintain, and so is often used as a rear guard or swarm attacker.\n\nIn war, mech armies are known to send militors into urban ruins to hunt down survivors after breaking the human defenses. For this reason, they are considered by some to be the most cruel of all mechanoid patterns.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Paramedic.label: solar paramedic
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Paramedic.description: A small solar mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Scorcher.label: solar scorcher
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Scorcher.description: A close-approach solar war mechanoid that specializes in incendiary attacks. Its flame burst attack has little reach, but once it closes on a group of defenders it can ignite and disrupt them with blasts of searing flame.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Tesseron.label: solar tesseron
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Tesseron.description: A solar medium-range combat mechanoid. While it is fairly vulnerable to attacks, the tesseron's sweeping beam graser can pierce thick armor and even ignite shielded targets.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Tunneler.label: solar tunneler
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_Tunneler.description: A heavy solar mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_WarUrchin.label: solar war urchin
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Mech_WarUrchin.description: A small, deployable solar combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war queen mech. War urchins are expendable fighters designed to swarm-attack enemies. They are mounted with short-ranged spiner guns and have a non-rechargeable power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_PPSH.label: Solar Power Suit Helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_PPSH.description: An older prototype version of the CMC series of power armor, the PPS was designed to give solid bulky protection and a rudimentary life support sistem in dangerous or low O2 battle situation.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_PPSa.label: Solar Power Suit
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_PPSa.description: A powerful power armor stylized to resemble the old Pressurized Power Suits, made with sunsteel.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Proj_BjornGrenadeEMP.label: EMP grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Proj_GrenadePhoenixFire.label: solar incendiary grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_Proj_GrenadierGrenade.label: solar frag grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_GuardianArmorBase.label: solar guardian armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_GuardianArmorBase.descripti: A suit of specialty solar power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields.
A suit of specialty solar power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields. \n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet.label: solar guardian helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet.descrip: A modified solar marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard solar marine helmet.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet_Prestig: A modified solar marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard solar marine helmet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmor.label: phalanx armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmor.description: A suit of heavy powered armor based on the standard Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer. \nMechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.label: solar phalanx helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.descript: A heavy solar Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard solar Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet_Prestige: A heavy solar Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard solar Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmor_Prestige.label: prestige solarphalanx armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_PhalanxArmor_Prestige.descr:
A suit of heavy solar powered armor based on the standard solar Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Mechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmor.label: solar ranseur armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmor.description: A highly specialized suit of light solar power-armor. Solar anseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time. \nRanseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.label: solar ranseur helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.descript: A high-tech armored helmet designed for use with a set of solar ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet_Prestige: A high-tech armored solar helmet designed for use with a set of solar ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmor_Prestige.label: prestige solar ranseur armor
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_RanseurArmor_Prestige.descr:
A highly specialized suit of light solar power-armor. Solar ranseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Ranseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_StealthBelt.label: personal solar cloaking system
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_RA_StealthBelt.description: An solar cloaking system worn on the belt. It is less efficient than a suit of solar ranseur armor, and it can only hold enough nuclear fuel for one charge at a time.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_SleepAccelerator.label: solarite sleep accelerator
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_SleepAccelerator.description: A solarite bedside device that accelerates the sleeper's circadian rhythm. This speeds up sleep, but consumes a lot of electricity and also causes increased hunger. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one sleep accelerator near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_VAE_Footwear_MarineBoots.label: solar marine boots
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_VAE_Footwear_MarineBoots.descr: A pair of solar marine boots with layered sunsteel plates and enhanced servomotors.
LanguageData.BOR_Solar_VAE_Handwear_MarineGloves.desc: A pair of solar marine gloves with enhanced grip assistance and set of embedded sunsteel recoil stabilisers.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorCataphract.des: A suit of heavy powered tenebral armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered tenebrite-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPhoe: A variant of tenebral cataphract armor with a shoulder-mounted flamebolt launcher. This armor is slightly less protective than standard cataphract armor against normal damage, but is especially flame-resistant. The flamebolt launcher has very limited ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nPhoenixes specialize in clearing out very confined spaces full of enemies, as in underground or shipborne operations. They can absorb hits while moving down a corridor, fill rooms with flame, and emerge from the smoke unscathed.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorCataphractPres: A suit of heavy powered tenebral armor, built for maximum protection at the cost of mobility. Heavy layered tenebrite-weave plates with solid ablative coatings stop all but the most well-aimed or powerful attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors prevent the suit's massive weight from immobilizing the wearer entirely, but the suit is still quite cumbersome.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorHelmetCataphra: A heavily-armored tenebral-tech helmet, with a solid tenebrite-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nArmor like this is used by imperial cataphracts to break heavily fortified positions in frontal assaults when no other option is available.

A heavily-armored tenebral-tech helmet, with a solid tenebrite-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorHelmetReconPre: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective tenebrite-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorLocust.label: tenebral locust armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorLocust.descrip: A variant of tenebral recon armor with an integrated burst rocket for short-ranged flight. Locust armor is slightly less protective than standard recon armor. Each jump consumes a burst of fuel, so the armor must be reloaded after several uses.\n\nUnlike most ultratech military units, locusts train primarily with melee weapons. They usually avoid static shootouts, preferring to jump straight into enemy fortifications and fight hand-to-hand. They do poorly in static defense or confined quarters, but excel in mixed cover or shipcracking operations.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorMarineGrenadie: A variant of tenebral marine armor with an integrated frag launcher on the shoulder. The armor is slightly less protective than standard marine armor. The launcher can only hold a limited amount of ammo and must be reloaded after use.\n\nGrenadiers usually specialize in breaching buildings or internal ship bulkheads. While not effective at very long range, grenadiers can be surprisingly deadly in confined quarters.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorMarineHelmetPr: A marine armor helmet, with a built-in status computer and layered tenebrite-weave plates.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ArmorMarinePrestige: A suit of powered armor. Layered tenebrite-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
A suit of light partially-powered tenebral armor, designed to permit quick movement. Tenebrite-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_AssaultArmor.label: tenebral assault armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_AssaultArmor.descri: An Ultra-heavy tenebral protective armor, "Bjorn IV" cladded with layers of composite tenebrite-weave and reactive armor plates. The wearer of this armor is practically become a walking tank. This armor achieved tremendous protection at the expense of moving speed. It has an integrated short-range EMP grenade launcher.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.label: tenebral assault helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_AssaultArmorH.descr: Rugged and trustworthy tenebral helmet of the tenebral assault armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_CloseCombatArmor.de: Tenebral power armor with a built-in shield, "Excelsior IV" is a close combat focused power armor with maneuverability, durability, and lethality.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_CloseCombatHelmet.d: Tenebral elmet of a "Excelsior IV" close combat armor. It assist wearer with neural close combat enhancement system.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Dropsuit.label: tenebral drop suit
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Dropsuit.descriptio: Yeonhwa Precision Tenebral Drop Suit model 412f, 'JanYeong(shadow remains) IV'. Built for the YeonHwa Aggresive Marketing Division's drop troops, this completely enclosed suit is designed to perform low orbit jump action. Its integrated long-ranged jump pack makes JanYeong ideal equipment for the rapid insertion mission.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_DropsuitH.label: tenebral dropsuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_DropsuitH.descripti: It is a state-of-the-art tenebral helmet, optimized for EVA and orbital drop operations. This helmet has lots of shiny gadgets. Of course, all of these flashing toys are useless in the surface environment except the targeting assist pseudo A.I.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Exoframe.label: tenebral exo-frame
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Exoframe.descriptio: A tenebral exoframe is a mobile machine that is powered by a system of motors, pneumatics, levers or hydraulics that allow for limb movement and assists the wearer by boosting their strength and endurance.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FSArmor.label: tenebral fire support armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FSArmor.description: If you need a walking turret, call the "Varg IV" tenebral fire support armor. Rapid reloading system, additional ammo container, built in fire control system, everything of the "Varg IV" focused on fire support. In return, the Varg is very vulnerable to close combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FSArmorH.label: tenebral fire support helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_FSArmorH.descriptio: Tenebral helmet of the tenebral "Varg IV" fire support armor. Share the features with the fire support armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Gunlink.label: gunlink
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Gunlink.description: A tenebral targeting computer that helps the user aim. It detects and analyzes targets using infrared, visible, and millimeter-wave electromagnetic sensors. An onboard targeting computer displays firing solutions on a retinal projection. It offers no protection at all.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_HazardCarapace.desc: The "Alecto IV" tenebral hazard carapace is designed to carry out mission even in the worst environment. In extreme cold area, in a heat wave, and even in radioactive wasteland, Tisiphone hunters can continue their endless hunting.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_HazardCarapaceH.des: A tenebral helmet of an "Alecto IV" hazard carapace. This helmet provides excellent environmental protection.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_HeavyMarineArmor.de: A suit of heavy powered tenebral armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered tenebrite-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Judicator.label: riot gear
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Judicator.descripti: A "Judicator" tenebral riot gear was produced by Arms Dynamics for Federation human commanders. This is a really great personal armor if you can withstand from scornful eyes of the people.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_JudicatorH.label: tenebral riot gear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_JudicatorH.descript: It is a tenebral helmet of the FPC riot gear. If you wear this, you will be an eyesore of your colony.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Korp.label: tenebral artillery armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Korp.description: A tenebral variant of the "Varg IV" tenebral fire support armor, the "Korp(Raven) IV" artillery armor originated from modified makeshift equipment of frontlines. All unnecessary equipment was removed from Korp to mount a huge mortar, "Crow feeder." The purpose of this equipment is simple; turn the wearer into walking artillery. The only ammunition this mortar can shoot is high-explosive shells.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MarksmanGear.label: tenebral marksman gear
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MarksmanGear.descri: Arms Dynamics "Condemner" tenebral Marksman gear. With joint stabilizer unit, this outfit assure steady aim. Standard issue gear of the Federation Peacebringer assassin corps.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.label: marksmangear helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MarksmanGearH.descr: It is a tenebral helmet of the "Condemner" marksman gear. Integrated target designator guarantees high accuracy.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MedicArmor.label: tenebral modular Medic armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MedicArmor.descript: Designed for combat medics, the "Hospitaller IV" tenebral armor is the medical variant of the "Warrior IV" tenebral modular body protection system. The armor is equipped with a variety of medical tools and supplies, so the wearer can treat the injured in the field.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MedicH.label: tenebral medic helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_MedicH.description: A tenebral helmet of the "Hospitaller IV" tenebral Medic armor. The built-in AI medical interface assists the wearer during medical procedures.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_NomadArmor.label: tenebral modular nomad armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_NomadArmor.descript: "Akicita IV", the long-range tenebral scout variant of the tenebral "Warrior IV" modular body protection system. This outfit recycles the wearer's body waste and moisture, provides heat and cold protection and sound dampening, and assists the wearer with servo motors and a lightweight exoskeleton. The wearer needs less sleep, moves faster, hunting quieter. Originally designed as a protective device for explorers, guerrillas and caravans of rimworlds soon realized the amazing potential of the equipment.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_NomadH.label: tenebral nomad helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_NomadH.description: A tenebral helmet of the "Akicita IV" tenebral nomad armor. Its long-range observation equipment can also be used for aiming.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PioneerArmor.label: tenebral modular pioneer armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PioneerArmor.descri: A tenebral armor designed primarily for combat engineer, Greydale "Laconian IV" pioneer armor has integrated tool set. It's a pretty good gear for builds something while gunfight.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PioneerH.label: tenebral pioneer helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_PioneerH.descriptio: A helmet of the "Laconian IV" pioneer armor. A simple pain damper system integrated.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ProtectiveGear.desc: A heavy, non-power assisted tenebral protective gear. While it doesn't have defensive strength of power armor, this armor covers your whole body.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ProtectiveHelmet.de: A heavy tenebral combat helmet. Protects whole head.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ReflactorArmor.desc: The "Nemesis IV" is a powered armor that created to hunt the Federation remnants. Almost immune to the heat energy, the Tisiphone Hunter Contingent provides this armor to their elite hunters.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_ReflactorArmorH.des: A tenebral helmet with a complete set of heat deflector system.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_RoyalSiegeArmor.des: A suit of heavy powered Tenebral armor, built for increased protection while still maintaining mobility. Heavy layered tenebrite-weave plates paired with a built-in energy shield emitter stop most attacks. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear this armor without immobilizing them entirely.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_RoyalTrooperArmor.d: A suit of light minimally-powered Tenebral armor. Lightweight tenebrite-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_SecurityArmor.label: tenebral modular security armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_SecurityArmor.descr: The tenebral configuration of the Greydale modular body protection system, the "Warrior IV" security armor provides modest protection for most body parts. If you have the proper equipment, It can be reassembled into other armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_SecurityHelmet.desc: A tenebral helmet of the "Warrior IV" tenebral security armor. A simple and robust protection gear.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Strikesuit.label: tenebral strike suit
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_Strikesuit.descript: Yeonhwa Precision Strike Suit model 383a, 'ChangWol(Azure Moon) IV'. Designed for urban strike teams, this sophisticated suit have short-ranged, fast jump thrusters for rapid assault. In order to maximize the operational capacity of this suit, the wearer requires fast reaction speed and exceptional boldness.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_StrikesuitH.label: tenebral strikesuit helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_StrikesuitH.descrip: A tenebral helmet of the delicate tenebral strike suit. Sophisticated nerve assist system inside this helmet makes the wearer act faster.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacArmor.label: tenebral tactical armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacArmor.descriptio: An ergonomically designed tenebral body armor. This type of armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacHelmet.label: tenebral tactical helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacHelmet.descripti: Advanced tenebral combat helmet designed specifically to protect the head during combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacVest.label: tenebral tactical vest
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TacVest.description: An ergonomically designed tenebral body armor. This type of tenebral armor increase wearer's combat efficiency.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TrooperArmor.label: tenebral trooper armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_TrooperArmor.descri: A suit of light minimally-powered armor. Lightweight tenebrite-weave plates block attacks, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body redistribute weight carried by its user. It is slimmer than other powered armor and can fit under clothes.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGCloak.label: unity guard tenebral cloak
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGCloak.description: Tenebral cloak that usually worn by the federation unity guards. It's more like to ornament than practical outfit.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGCuirass.label: unity guard tenebral cuirass
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGCuirass.descripti: Standard issue tenebral body armor of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGHelmet.label: unity guard tenebral helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Apparel_UGHelmet.descriptio: Standard issue tenebral helmet of the federation unity guards.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Bullet_Crowfeeder.label: crow feeder tenebral shell
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Bullet_MiniShotgun.label: tenebral shotgun blast
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Bullet_NeedleGun.label: tenebral needle shot
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Bullet_Spiner.label: tenebral spine
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Bullet_ToxicNeedleGun.label: tenebral toxic needle
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Carbonsuit.label: tenebral bodysuit
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Carbonsuit.description: A full tenebral bodysuit made of tenebrite crystalline fiber. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_FedSuit.label: tenebral federation jumpsuit
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_FedSuit.description: A carbon crystalline fiber tenebral jumpsuit for military personnel. It is light and thin, but surprisingly sturdy. It is the uniform of the Federation.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_BeamGraser.label: tenebral beam graser
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_BeamGraser.description: A high-energy gamma ray laser which fires a sweeping beam that pierces thick armor and burns targets. Because of the health risks, grasers are usually only used by mechanoids. This one was made to interface directly with a mechanoid wielder and draw from its power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.label: tenebral mini-flameblaster
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_MiniFlameblaster.descri: A small burst-oriented flamethrower used by mechanoids.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_MiniShotgun.label: tenebral mini-shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_MiniShotgun.description: A compact, short-range shotgun designed to be mounted on a light combat mechanoid.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_NeedleLauncher.label: tenebral needle launcher
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_NeedleLauncher.descript: This mechanoid weapon is a compact version of the needle gun. Named after its needle-like projectiles, it fires single shots with great accuracy. The needle launcher has less range than its counterpart but is lightweight, allowing it to be wielded by fast-moving mechs.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_Spiner.label: tenebral spiner
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_Spiner.description: A very small gun used by war urchins which quickly fires spine-like projectiles. It is short-ranged but deadly.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_ToxicNeedle.label: tenebral toxic needle gun
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Gun_ToxicNeedle.description: A mechanoid-built gun that fires toxin-infused metal needles. It can fire long distances and will poison the target in addition to doing physical damage.
A heavily-armored tenebral-tech helmet, with a solid tenebrite-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial stormtroopers and glitterworld peacekeepers.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Headgear_RoyalSiegeHelmet.d: A heavily-armored Tenebral-tech helmet, with a solid tenebrite-weave shell and omni-spectrum camera.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Headgear_RoyalTrooperHelmet: A Tenebral-tech and lightweight armored helmet with a protective tenebrite-weave plate.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Headgear_TrooperHelmet.desc: A high-tech and lightweight armored tenebral helmet with a protective tenebrite-weave plate.\n\nArmor like this is often used by imperial conscripts and late-midworld military forces.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Agrihand.label: tenebral agrihand
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Agrihand.description: A small tenebral mechanoid designed to sow and harvest crops. While it is better suited to labor than combat, it can fight with built-in cutting blades if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Apocriton.label: tenebral apocriton
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Apocriton.description: A tenebral mechanoid commander designed to coordinate and motivate other mechs during long extermination campaigns. Its most obvious power is its ability to resurrect recently-killed mechs by supercharging their self-repair processes. Less obviously, it is intelligent and psychically present, radiating hatred into the minds of anyone in a wide radius. It can also move quickly with its built-in jump launcher.\n\nWhile all mechanoids have a dim psychically-present intelligence, only the apocriton and a few others truly feel hatred for their victims and understand the suffering they inflict.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Cleansweeper.label: tenebral cleansweeper
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Cleansweeper.descripti: A light tenebral mechanoid designed for cleaning. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Constructoid.label: tenebral constructoid
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Constructoid.descripti: A small tenebral mechanoid designed to perform construction tasks. It can perform blunt melee attacks if necessary.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Fabricor.label: tenebral fabricor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Fabricor.description: A small tenebral work mechanoid designed to craft all manner of manufactured objects.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Legionary.label: tenebral legionary
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Legionary.description: A tenebral combat support mechanoid with a wide-range bullet shield and mid-range needle gun. Designed to support other mechanoids, the legionary is vulnerable to anyone who can get inside its shield.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Lifter.label: tenebral lifter
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Lifter.description: A small tenebral mechanoid designed for hauling. Lacking a ranged weapon, it can make only weak melee attacks.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Militor.label: tenebral militor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Militor.description: A small combat tenebral mechanoid armed with a low-power mini-shotgun. Roughly four feet tall, militors lack the power, range, and toughness of more senior combat mechs. However, it is cheap to gestate and maintain, and so is often used as a rear guard or swarm attacker.\n\nIn war, mech armies are known to send militors into urban ruins to hunt down survivors after breaking the human defenses. For this reason, they are considered by some to be the most cruel of all mechanoid patterns.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Paramedic.label: tenebral paramedic
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Paramedic.description: A small tenebral mechanoid designed for non-violent emergency situation management and medical care. The paramedic can rescue the wounded, fight fires, treat the sick, and even perform surgery when a more-qualified human is not available. Its built-in jump launcher allows it to jump into, and out of, emergency situations, and its built-in firefoam popper can quickly extinguish fires.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Scorcher.label: tenebral scorcher
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Scorcher.description: A close-approach tenebral war mechanoid that specializes in incendiary attacks. Its flame burst attack has little reach, but once it closes on a group of defenders it can ignite and disrupt them with blasts of searing flame.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Tesseron.label: tenebral tesseron
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Tesseron.description: A tenebral medium-range combat mechanoid. While it is fairly vulnerable to attacks, the tesseron's sweeping beam graser can pierce thick armor and even ignite shielded targets.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Tunneler.label: tenebral tunneler
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_Tunneler.description: A heavy tenebral mechanoid built for mining in treacherous locations. While intended for excavation, the tunneler's gigantic power claws and ultra-thick armor makes it a dangerous force in combat.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_WarUrchin.label: tenebral war urchin
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Mech_WarUrchin.description: A small, deployable tenebral combat mechanoid usually manufactured inside an ultra-heavy war queen mech. War urchins are expendable fighters designed to swarm-attack enemies. They are mounted with short-ranged spiner guns and have a non-rechargeable power source.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_PPSH.label: Tenebral Power Suit Helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_PPSH.description: An older prototype version of the CMC series of power armor, the PPS was designed to give solid bulky protection and a rudimentary life support sistem in dangerous or low O2 battle situation.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_PPSa.label: Tenebral Power Suit
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_PPSa.description: A powerful power armor stylized to resemble the old Pressurized Power Suits, made with tenebrite alloys.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Proj_BjornGrenadeEMP.label: EMP grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_Proj_GrenadierGrenade.label: tenebral frag grenade
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_GuardianArmorBase.label: tenebral guardian armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_GuardianArmorBase.descri: A suit of specialty tenebral power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_GuardianArmorBase_Presti: A suit of specialty tenebral power armor designed with extra defensive measures. A personal countermeasure system is mounted on the back, capable of rapidly launching EMP grenades to disrupt turrets and energy shields. \n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet.desc: A modified tenebral marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard tenebral marine helmet.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_GuardianArmorHelmet_Pres: A modified tenebral marine helmet with an added armor plate in the front. It offers improved protection over a standard tenebral marine helmet.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmor.label: phalanx armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmor.description: A suit of heavy powered armor based on the standard Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer. \nMechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.label: tenebral phalanx helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet.descr: A heavy tenebral Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard tenebral Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmorHelmet_Prest: A heavy tenebral Phalanx helmet. It offers better protection than a standard tenebral Cataphract helmet, and it has a built-in filter that removes most toxins and other harmful chemicals from the air before the wearer can breathe them.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_PhalanxArmor_Prestige.de:
A suit of heavy tenebral powered armor based on the standard tenebral Cataphract design. It features defensive improvements, including stronger armor plating and a reusable low-shield deployer.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Mechanites within the low-shield deployer can replicate the shield core in-between uses, but the unit must be resupplied with advanced components.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmor.label: tenebral ranseur armor
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmor.description: A highly specialized suit of light tenebral power-armor. Tenebral anseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time. \nRanseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.label: tenebral ranseur helmet
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet.descr: A high-tech armored helmet designed for use with a set of tenebral ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmorHelmet_Prest: A high-tech armored tenebral helmet designed for use with a set of tenebral ranseur armor. It features an internal heads-up display with a targeting computer similar to those found in Gunlinks.\n\nExpensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_RanseurArmor_Prestige.de:
A highly specialized suit of light tenebral power-armor. Tenebral ranseur armor cannot protect as well as standard Recon armor, but it is highly optimized for stealth and reconissance operations. It features an advanced cloaking device in its core that can render its wearer invisible for extended periods of time.

Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded eltex threads also enhance the wearer's psychic sensitivity. 
Ranseur armor requires excessive power when its cloaking device is active, and its reactor must be resupplied with uranium after sufficient use.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_StealthBelt.label: personal tenebral cloaking system
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_RA_StealthBelt.description: An tenebral cloaking system worn on the belt. It is less efficient than a suit of tenebral ranseur armor, and it can only hold enough nuclear fuel for one charge at a time.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_SleepAccelerator.label: tenebralite sleep accelerator
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_SleepAccelerator.descriptio: A tenebral bedside device that accelerates the sleeper's circadian rhythm. This speeds up sleep, but consumes a lot of electricity and also causes increased hunger. It must be placed directly adjacent to and facing the head of the bed. Placing more than one sleep accelerator near the same bed has no effect.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_VAE_Footwear_MarineBoots.de: A pair of tenebral marine boots with layered tenebrite plates and enhanced servomotors.
LanguageData.BOR_Tenebral_VAE_Handwear_MarineGloves.d: A pair of tenebral marine gloves with enhanced grip assistance and set of embedded tenebrite recoil stabilisers.
